contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTAN[...] MAX AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Obverse legend reads CONSTAN[...] MAX AVG. Obverse shows Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.4g, diameter is 16.82mm
